notes: A PvP arena with no guns anywhere in it is Action rather than Shooter — a shared clash space, not firing corridors — and an 8-player free-for-all in a fantasy colosseum is the Battlegrounds preset on its default space-bounded flat arena, which is exactly the central combat floor the author described. I dropped the preset's hazard-kill ring-out edges because the author wrapped the arena in detailed stone walls, which is the opposite of open edges to be knocked off, and added spectator-zone for the stands they asked for; the columns of cover-los land naturally as the colosseum's arches. The raised seating is what puts tiered on the route, and there is no reason to go further since nothing overhangs the floor and nobody goes indoors. With no user to ask, I assumed the stands are scenery and a place for eliminated players to watch rather than a second playable level, and read 'with detail' as a request for dense stone architectural dressing rather than any change to the space.
